default.about: living/configs/models.json as it stands. Since 694821c/b8cfdba people think with glm-flash (zai-glm-5-3-flash) at reasoning effort low for think and high for deliberate, talk, consolidate and internalize, max_tokens 24000, prompt caching on, overflow deepseek-flash; animals think, remember and compile with glm-flash. Level of detail and lessons off.

deepseek-flash.about: People think with deepseek-flash (deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017; overflow glm-flash); otherwise as default.

lod.about: Default with LIVING_LOD=1 (no player on stage).

glm-flash-low.about: People think with glm-flash sent with reasoning_effort low for every purpose. Replaying one real compile request (2026-11-09): as sent, 43.8 s with 5,742 reasoning tokens of 6,149 completion; with low, 3.4 s, 0 reasoning and 211 completion tokens; "none" is refused (HTTP 400). Before 694821c the profile sent no effort; since 694821c/b8cfdba main sets per-purpose efforts, and this variant overrides them all to low.

deliberate-low.about: As default, with glm-flash's deliberate (compile) effort lowered from high to low; think stays low, talk/consolidate/internalize stay high. A patch to living/configs/models.json, merged as given.

instinct.about: No mind: the subject lives on its graph alone (instinct-only control, e.g. for wolf packs).

people.about: People think with the `people` mix of living/configs/models.json as their default (think glm-flash; deliberate deepseek-flash@low on stage, glm-flash off stage; talk deepseek-flash; consolidate and reorganize glm-flash).

recall600.about: Default with LIVING_RECALL_TOKENS=decide=600 (main's default is decide=800).

animal-switches.about: Default with LIVING_ANIMAL_MINDS=pack,salient,choose: one mind per pack, think on salient change, one-call choice from a menu (docs/MIND_HARNESS.md item 3).

arrive-control.about: Default with the shipped newcomer laws (all 0): the arrival trial's control.

arrive-notice.about: Default with `newcomer_salience` 0.5 (skills_patch): the first sight of a newcomer within 60 m of one's home has salience 0.45 + 0.5 x mean(curiosity, sociability)/100 (0.45-0.95), a crowd does not hide it, and at 0.6 or more (mean temperament 30 or more) it asks for a thought. Hypothesis: nobody is asked to think when a stranger appears.

arrive-known.about: Default with `newcomer_scene_min` 30 (skills_patch): in every scene a newcomer (who came into the world, and was first seen, more than 10 s after one came into it, and is not of one's community) first seen within 30 minutes carries "new to you": "first seen N minutes ago". Information only, no trigger. Hypothesis: when residents do think, the newcomer reads like any neighbour whose name is out of range ("a stranger").

arrive-wonder.about: Default with `newcomer_drive_s` 90 (skills_patch): a calm person with no feelings about a newcomer within 12 m feels "You find yourself wondering about ..." (a feeling that asks for a thought) 45-135 s after first seeing them, sooner the more curious and sociable; once per newcomer per 10 minutes, within 30 minutes of the first sight. Hypothesis: no drive is fed by people one sees.

arrive-all.about: Default with all three newcomer laws: `newcomer_salience` 0.5, `newcomer_scene_min` 30, `newcomer_drive_s` 90.
